conclusion: W_i(LO)=0 implies RT(J_i) <= C_i(HI) and excludes every positive-start Case 2 candidate
exact_statement: For protected HI task i, if W_i(LO)=0, then the only valid relative-start branch is s=0 and the protected response satisfies RT(J_i) <= C_i(HI). The ordinary positive-start Case 2 recurrence is not evaluated and no positive-start candidate is added.
